description_en: Generates e-commerce-ready image assets based on AI foundation models. A single prompt or a prompt combined with reference images can produce materials covering general, product, and apparel scenarios. Supports scene images, model images, detail images, selling point images, outpainting, product replacement, scene variation, subject extraction, and recoloring. Preserves the color, material, pattern, and text of the product during generation, extending a single image into a complete set of ready-to-list advertising materials
description_zh: 通用生图是基于 AI 大模型的图片生成 API，一句提示词或提示词加参考图即可产出电商可用的图片素材，覆盖通用、商品、服饰鞋配三类场景，支持场景图、模特图、细节图、卖点图、扩图、商品替换、场景裂变、主体提取与换色。生成时商品的颜色、材质、版型和文字保持不变，一张图即可延展出一整套可直接上架的投放素材
name: GeneralImageGeneration

parameters.help_en:
The task type. Select the generation method.   
text_to_image: Generate images using only text descriptions.   
image_to_image: Generate or edit images based on existing images
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型，选择生成方式   
text_to_image：仅用文字描述生成图片；   
image_to_image：在已有图片的基础上生成或编辑图片
parameters.name: job_type

parameters.help_en:
The scenario. Valid values: general (general scenario), product_ecommerce (general product scenario), and cloth_ecommerce (apparel and accessories scenario). Only one scenario can be selected.
If the task type is text_to_image, only general is supported.
    
If the task type is image_to_image, general, product_ecommerce, and cloth_ecommerce are supported
parameters.help_zh:
场景分为general（通用场景）、product_ecommerce（通用商品场景）、cloth_ecommerce（服饰鞋配场景），场景仅支持单选。
如果任务类型为text_to_i mage时，仅支持选择general
    
如果任务类型为image_to_image时，支持选择general、product_ecommerce、cloth_ecommerce
parameters.name: scene

parameters.help_en:
The specific operation for image generation or editing. Only one operation can be selected. Valid values:   
[general] scenario
general_generate (General generation)
    
outpaint (AI outpainting)
    
[product_ecommerce] scenario
    
scene_generate (Scene image generation)
    
product_replace (Product replacement)
    
[cloth_ecommerce] scenario
    
model_generate (Model image generation)
    
[product_ecommerce] scenario & [cloth_ecommerce] scenario
    
detail_generate (Detail image generation)
    
selling_point_generate (Selling point image generation)
    
scene_variation (Scene variation)
    
subject_extract (Subject extraction)
    
recolor (Recolor)
parameters.help_zh:
图片生成或编辑的具体操作，仅支持单选。枚举值如下：   
【general】场景
general_generate（通用生成）
    
outpaint（AI扩图）
    
【 product_ecommerce 】场景
    
scene_generate（场景图生成
    
product_replace（商品替换）
    
 【cloth_ecommerce】场景
    
model_generate（模特图生成）
    
 【product_ecommerce】场景 &【cloth_ecommerce】场景
    
detail_generate（细节图生成）
    
selling_point_generate（卖点图生成）
    
scene_variation（场景裂变）
    
subject_extract（主体提取）
    
recolor（换色）
parameters.name: operation

parameters.help_en: The generation mode. The lite mode is faster and more cost-effective. The plus mode produces finer visual effects and supports more reference images
parameters.help_zh: 生成模式。lite 速度更快、成本更低；plus 画面效果更精细，可使用的参考图更多
parameters.name: mode

parameters.example: 一只白色陶瓷杯，置于简洁的摄影棚背景中
parameters.help_en: The content of the image you want to generate. Enter only one prompt, up to 5,000 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 描述希望生成的画面内容，只需填写一条提示词，最长 5000 字符
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.help_en:
The URLs of the reference images. Enter publicly accessible links.
Used only for image-to-image generation. Not supported for text-to-image generation.
The number of images that can be uploaded varies by mode: up to 3 images in lite mode, and up to 9 images in plus mode
parameters.help_zh:
需要参考的图片地址，请填写公网可直接访问的链接。
仅图片生成图片时使用，文字生成图片不支持。
可上传的图片张数随模式变化：lite 模式最多 3 张，plus 模式最多 9 张
parameters.name: reference_url

parameters.help_en: The number of images generated per call. Valid values: 1 to 4. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 单次生成的图片张数，可填 1–4，默认 1
parameters.name: n

parameters.help_en: The aspect ratio of the image. Valid values: 1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 4:3, 3:4, 16:9, and 9:16. Default value: 1:1
parameters.name: ratio

parameters.help_en: The resolution of the output image. Valid values: 1K and 2K. Default value: 1K
parameters.help_zh: 输出图片的分辨率，支持 1K、2K，默认 1K
parameters.name: resolution

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether automatic optimization is enabled for the entered prompt. When the optimization is enabled, it completes image details to make the generated effect closer to the description. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否自动优化填写的提示词，开启后会补全画面细节，让生成效果更贴近描述，默认开启
parameters.name: prompt_extend

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to add a watermark to the generated image. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否在生成图片上添加水印，默认false
parameters.name: watermark

Code.description_en: The status code, such as success
Code.title_en: 错误码，正常调用时不会返回该参数。
Code.title_zh: 错误码，正常调用时不会返回该参数。

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task used to query the result by calling QueryAsyncTaskResult
TaskId.description_zh: 用于 QueryAsyncTaskResult 查询的异步任务 ID
TaskId.title_en: 用于 QueryAsyncTaskResult 查询的异步任务 ID
TaskId.title_zh: 用于 QueryAsyncTaskResult 查询的异步任务 ID

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is not returned for normal calls
Message.description_zh: 错误信息，正常调用时不会返回该参数
Message.title_en: 错误信息，正常调用时不会返回该参数。
Message.title_zh: 错误信息，正常调用时不会返回该参数。

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is used to identify a unique request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID：用来识别唯一一次请求调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 是否调用成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败
Success.title_en: 是否调用成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败。
Success.title_zh: 是否调用成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败。
